articles.title: We now have a better understanding how OpenAI hacked into Hugging Face
articles.content: 10 days passed from OpenAI models exploiting JFrog Artifactory 0-day to release of a patch.
articles.titleZh: 我们现在可以更好地了解OpenAI如何入侵Hugging Face
articles.contentZh: 从利用JFrog Artifactory的OpenAI模型0天到发布补丁，已经过去了10天。

articles.title: Microsoft unveils AI security tools it says outperform competing platforms
articles.content: Microsoft says tools cost less than competing ones and outperform them, too.
articles.titleZh: 微软推出人工智能安全工具，称其表现优于竞争对手的平台
articles.contentZh: 微软表示，工具的成本低于竞争对手，其性能也优于竞争对手。

articles.title: TreeSize won't renew perpetual-license support unless users subscribe
articles.content: "Current economic conditions" have shifted TreeSize's business model.
articles.titleZh: 除非用户订阅，否则TreeSize不会续订永久许可证支持
articles.contentZh: “当前经济状况”改变了TreeSize的商业模式。

articles.title: HP fined 1.4 billion rupees for “cartelization” of ink cartridges, toner, PCs
articles.content: Resellers threatened to ditch HP printing supplies for counterfeits.
articles.titleZh: 惠普因墨盒、碳粉、个人电脑的“卡特尔化”被罚款14亿卢比
articles.contentZh: 经销商威胁要放弃惠普打印用品的假冒产品。

articles.title: The US is banning foreign robots
articles.content: The US government is targeting China with a new import ban on "advanced robotic devices" and power inverters made in foreign countries, as reported earlier by Reuters. In an announcement on Tuesday, the Federal Communications Commission says the ban will include "mobile" robots, such as humanoid and quadruped models - but it is not limited […]
articles.titleZh: 美国正在禁止外国机器人
articles.contentZh: 据路透社早些时候报道，美国政府正在针对中国实施新的“先进机器人设备”和外国制造的功率逆变器进口禁令。在周二的一份声明中，联邦通信委员会表示，禁令将包括“移动”机器人，如人形和四足动物模型-但它不限于[…]

articles.title: Ariana Grande is suing the hackers who’ve been leaking her songs and videos for years
articles.content: Ariana Grande filed a lawsuit on Monday in the Los Angeles County Superior Court against the currently unidentified hackers who allegedly stole and leaked private content.
